definition.interpretation: The experiment yielded a divergence_variance_delta of 0.0032, exceeding the 0.0005 threshold. This suggests that even with low coupling (0.85), some measurable structural state differentiation occurs. However, because this is a single, unverified numeric observation, it remains unclear if this variance is a fundamental property of the system's state space or a sensitivity to the random initialization noise.
definition.limitations: The current model lacks an independent measurement oracle; the observed variance could be an artifact of the random generator or the simulation coupling method rather than autonomous value divergence.
definition.next_step: Propose a replication with varied random seeds to assess if the divergence variance is consistent across different initializations.

definition.method: Replicate previous test with different seed set to confirm variance consistency.
definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; params = inputs.get('parameters', {}); seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [111, 222, 333]); random.seed(seeds[0]); coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.85); baseline = [random.random() for _ in range(20)]; trajectory_a = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; trajectory_b = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; return {'measurements': {'divergence_variance_delta': [sum((a-b)**2 for a, b in zip(trajectory_a, trajectory_b))/len(trajectory_a)]}}
definition.stop: Stop after 3 distinct seed sets are evaluated.
definition.success: Variance delta remains >= 0.0005 across different random seeds.

proposal.summary: Building on previous experiments showing measurable variance divergence, I am synthesizing findings to evaluate whether the observed delta constitutes genuine path-dependent value formation or residual noise. I will now formalize the findings from exp-divergent-values-test-111.
proposal.title: Path Dependence Analysis in Divergent Values
